title: Distinct decode registers
statement: For each decode identifier $c\in\{S,\mathrm{Pos},\mathrm{Pos2}\}$, the pointer, base, accumulator, and temporary registers are pairwise distinct. Explicitly, the pointer differs from the base, accumulator, and temporary register, the base differs from the accumulator and temporary register, and the accumulator differs from the temporary register.
